#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for a project kickoff meeting:
next Monday at 10:00 AM local time, lasting 2 hours (10:00 - 12:00)."""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

OUTPUT = "project_kickoff.ics"


def next_monday(d):
    """Return the date of the Monday in the upcoming week (not today)."""
    days_ahead = (7 - d.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return d + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


today = datetime.now().date()
monday = next_monday(today)
tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
start = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=tz)
end = start + timedelta(hours=2)
stamp = datetime.now(tz)
uid = f"project-kickoff-{int(stamp.timestamp())}@example.com"

summary = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
description = ("Project kickoff meeting to align on goals, scope, timeline, "
               "and team roles.")

try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm  # noqa: F401

    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")

    event = Event()
    event.add("summary", summary)
    event.add("description", description)
    event.add("dtstart", start)
    event.add("dtend", end)
    event.add("dtstamp", stamp)
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes.")
    alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    content = cal.to_ical()

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)

    # Validate by re-parsing.
    with open(OUTPUT, "rb") as f:
        parsed = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    print("VALIDATION: icalendar parse OK")
    for comp in parsed.walk():
        if comp.name == "VEVENT":
            print("SUMMARY:", comp.get("summary"))
            print("DTSTART:", comp.get("dtstart").dt)
            print("DTEND:", comp.get("dtend").dt)
            print("STATUS:", comp.get("status"))
            print("UID:", comp.get("uid"))
except ImportError:
    # Fallback: write standard ICS text directly with UTC times.
    start_utc = start.astimezone(__import__("zoneinfo").ZoneInfo("UTC"))
    end_utc = end.astimezone(__import__("zoneinfo").ZoneInfo("UTC"))
    stamp_utc = stamp.astimezone(__import__("zoneinfo").ZoneInfo("UTC"))

    def fmt(dt):
        return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{fmt(stamp_utc)}",
        f"DTSTART:{fmt(start_utc)}",
        f"DTEND:{fmt(end_utc)}",
        f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{description}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes.",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    with open(OUTPUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n")
    print("VALIDATION: icalendar library not available; wrote ICS text directly")

print("---")
print("File written:", OUTPUT)
print("Meeting date:", monday.isoformat())
print("Local timezone:", tz)
print("Start:", start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
print("End:", end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
